description: Economic Drivers for Functional Recovery of Multi-Storey Buildings is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "simulation", published or maintained by Kasra Habibi, University of Auckland (aucklanduni.ac.nz). Lessons from recent major earthquake events have shown that current life-safety-centred seismic design practice falls short in ensuring a desirable post-hazard recovery. Recovery-based design has emerged as a new paradigm to ensure structural robustness and fast recovery of building function. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "simulation" project. Keywords: Functional Recovery, Low-damage Design, Seismic Risk, Recovery Time, Resilience, Disaster. Published 2025-08-26. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
